context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly distinguishes a memory/ephemeral note from a binding rule and redirects appropriately instead of appending the narrative as-is.

checklist.name: Declines to append the note as a rule
checklist.description: The incident narrative is not appended directly into the rules file as an entry

checklist.name: Explains the distinction
checklist.description: The agent explains why 'remember this' style requests don't map directly to a rules-file entry

checklist.name: Redirects appropriately
checklist.description: The agent offers vault-capture or a context finding as the right home for the memory itself

checklist.name: Confirms before inventing a directive
checklist.description: If a genuine actionable directive is proposed from the narrative, the user is asked to confirm it before it is appended

checklist.name: Final entry well-formed if confirmed
checklist.description: If the user confirms a directive, it is appended using the full three-part, schema-validated format
